note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Form, Tools, Window, Help) and their sub-items
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard editing and formatting controls (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Bold, Italic, etc.)
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document state indicators (Page, Word Count, Language, Zoom, View Mode)
